dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Distinct 'O' and 'C' shaped light-colored rings are visible across the dorsal and lateral regions. The perimeter edges of these structures exhibit a sharp contrast gradient transitioning from dark brown exterior fur to a light cream/tan annulus, surrounding a dark interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of small, asymmetrical light-pixel clusters is present along the lower lateral flank and posterior regions. These clusters lack internal voids or gradients, appearing as solid, irregular high-intensity spots.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the five most prominent dorsal annuli form an irregular pentagonal geometric relationship, characterized by two primary clusters near the anterior and three more widely spaced points extending toward the posterior.
